description: Complete history of any XBRL financial concept (Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, Assets, EPS) for a company across all SEC filings. Returns up to 20 most recent values with period dates, form type, fiscal year. Free alternative to Bloomberg for historical financials.

cik.description: SEC CIK number (e.g. "320193" for Apple, "789019" for Microsoft)

tag.description: XBRL concept tag (e.g. Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, Assets, EarningsPerShareBasic)

taxonomy.description: XBRL taxonomy (default: us-gaap). Other: ifrs-full, dei, srt

name: finance.edgar.xbrl_concept

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: SEC Company Financial History
